notes.title: Treasure Chest Rewards Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32762462/b6a476f173d70445842d91143b695b6f700f7a51.jpg[/img]

Treasure Chests are here!  Pass quizzes to get the following:
[list]
[*] 60% = Wood Treasure Chest: elements that make up the chest
[*] 70% = Bronze Treasure Chest: 2 coins + elements that make up the bronze chest
[*] 80% = Silver Treasure Chest: 4 coins +  silver (which makes up the chest)
[*] 90% = Gold Treasure Chest: 8 coins +  gold (which makes up the chest)
[*] 100% = Diamond Treasure Chest: 16 coins +  the element that makes up the chest
[/list]
These rewards are in addition to the ability points and medals that are already awarded for completing quizzes.  The treasure chests can be collected repeatedly by passing the quizzes repeatedly.  The quizzes are different per attempt, and pull 10 questions from a list of 25 questions.  This is the April Fools event reward, and is planned to remain in the game!  I plan to add stuff to buy with the coins soon.  You can currently see how many coins you have by seeing how much cobalt you have - I plan on adding a coin display soon as well.

notes.title: Twitch Stream and Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32762462/27f6d3d60698ab4fc1363d2b1427b91ab41d0d06.png[/img]

I have fixed a few more bugs that Real_Bytes_Gaming found on her Twitch stream.  Planetary Settlers is streaming tonight at midnight (technically 1/25/2021) Eastern Standard Time at: [url=https://www.twitch.tv/real_bytes_gaming]https://www.twitch.tv/real_bytes_gaming[/url]
[list]
[b]Bug fixes include:[/b]
[*] Fixed issue with brightness on Uranus and Neptune (now it doesn't get extremely dim when looking near / at the sun, but it now properly dims a little bit).  Brightness throughout the two levels is also better.
[*] Mostly fixed character facing the wrong way when exiting portals.
[*] Updated the controls menu to include the new ability to use the F key (or E key), whichever you desire, as the action button.
[*] On Uranus: made ship engine flames less laggy, and turned them off when parked.  This prevents the lag spike that was observed in the last stream in the hanger.

[b]Feature updates include:[/b]
[*] Updated title screen with the vast majority of the title screen visible now (and not hidden by the game saves menu).  Click the Game Saves menu, then make your selection - as before, or Resume Game to resume your current game.
[*] Updated Credits page
[*] Clarified Nanites are what gives you your ability points - it shows up in the menu now as Ability Points (Nanites).  They are microscopic robots that can be used to upgrade Blue-42's abilities, and are able to be re-allocated as desired in the abilities tab.
[/list]

Here's a tip for those that have made it this far: It can be a big help to adjust your ability points to meet the current challenge, like, for a race, you can turn down things you don't need at the time, and max out speed.

A second tip: Speed also affects your speed in the air!  If you need more control in the air, try to max your speed out.  If you need more (or less) lift, adjust your jet pack.  Enjoy!

notes.title: Good Sport Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32762462/892a7b02574de7e1e64c3625667450f612bad21a.png[/img]
[list][*] Now you can find and unlock different sports balls (5 total, in addition to your regular ball) to launch!  Once unlocked, find them under your Ability tab!
[*] In Normal mode, sports balls are unlocked by finding a hidden console (hidden in secret areas), where you walk up to download the blueprint.  Once you find a blueprint, you can launch the balls by pausing, going to the Abilities tab, and selecting your desired ball (lower right corner).  When you left click, you will now launch this as a projectile!
[*] If you want immediate access to them, you can go play in Open Exploration mode, where they are already unlocked.
[*] Customize their color under the Color tab!  Select Projectile, then pick your color.  You can pick a color from the menu, or make your own color with the RGB sliders.  You can also select Glow, and make the ball glow in the dark, whatever color you pick!  Hint - try sliding it on the RGB bar down to a low value if you want an authentic glow in the dark look (otherwise it will be bright enough to glow brightly in the day light, which you may want to try as well).  While you are here, might as well mess with your light color!  While this was here already, it is a lot more fun to try with different sports balls!
[*] Multiple bug fixes and improvements have been made as well.  The way points on the alien mission are now brighter / easier to see, and now you can walk right up to the edge of the moon dome (inside and outside).
[/list]
Thank you all for being good sports during this trying time!   Together as a society, I am sure we will get through this.  Hopefully this update brings some happiness as well!

notes.title: Graphics Update - Settings from Retro to Epic
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32762462/795361f940bb827423ae583a8ecb2bc62293c288.png[/img]
I have made it so you can access the graphics menu in game, instead of having to go back to the title screen to make adjustments.  Just pause (p) and go to the Graphics tab.  Pick your desired settings and press Apply.  I have also added 4 new graphics presets (fastest running first):
[list]
  [*] [b]Retro[/b]: Do you like the feel of the old time games?
Go to Graphics, click "Retro" and enjoy a look that is a "blast from the past!"  This is the fastest frames per second built in setting.
  [*] [b]Fast[/b]: This is designed to run fast, use this setting or retro if you are lagging while playing Planetary Settlers.  Fast optimizes the graphics to run fast while still looking halfway decent.
[*] [b]Default[/b]: This is the way Planetary Settlers used to run before I added graphics options.  If you like the current look and feel, you can stick with this, but feel free to experiment with the other settings!
[*] [b]Epic[/b]: Crank it up to the max and enjoy the best graphics available in Planetary Settlers.  This will probably run slowly (low frames per second) though, unless you have a really nice gaming computer.  If your computer runs even this setting fast, play on and enjoy the view!
[/list]

notes.title: Diamond Medals Update
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32762462/29ec058c218f25da2beadeaec23ec6ebd920bf42.png[/img]

In the latest update, I made it so that you can get diamond medals for each medal.  Earlier, some medals had a highest level of gold, and others diamond for doing extremely well on the challenge.  Now that they are all diamond, you can know when you have finished each challenge.

I also made it so the rocks are "solid".  Now if you hit a small rock, it will bounce you a bit, and a large rock will stop you, instead of going through it.  You can still pick up the large "loose" rocks like you could before.  I have tested the races and increased the times to beat where rocks are a factor, so they are still achievable.

The Overachiever's contest is still on through the month of August!  Only one person (other than me) has gotten the Blur 42 achievement, and no one else has gotten the Valedictorian achievement yet.  Can you get either of these challenging achievements this month?  If you do this, you have earned the honor to be listed in the credits for future players to see!

notes.title: Alien Update!
notes.notes:
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32762462/61347486484e290f027539b1aba2dbb3ffcf9ef2.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32762462/9726ed4df610bd9f32d07c2d0c80f97ed1968e70.png[/img][/url]

I've been hard at work, adding new missions and achievements to the alien level (an A'kramm ship orbiting the sun), and it is released!  All medals on this level are now implemented.

Now you can negotiate with the A'kramm from a communication console (located at the bottom of the ship), which may result in several interesting outcomes / endings.  If you declare war, they will immediately destroy the sun and solar system!  Otherwise, they may try to destroy you and cause more havoc by starting another solar flare, or pursue peace depending on what you say to them.  Our fate is in your hands!

If the A'kramm try to initiate another solar flare, you can make their plan backfire by deploying nanites at key points on the ship to cause the energy pulse to destroy their ship instead!  Hurry though, you won't have much time.  You must reach these points and then escape through the portal before the ship is destroyed!

There are now three new achievements!  Stop the A'kramm in one of multiple possible ways (using the consoles at the base of the ship) to beat the first main quest and earn the winner achievement!  Replay the level and experience all the endings to unlock the "Many Worlds Interpretation" achievement.  This is a reference to the "Many Worlds Interpretation" of Quantum Mechanics.  I don't know if that interpretation is correct, but it is definitely interesting.

Can you stop the A'kramm faster than the developer, with 52 or more seconds still remaining on the clock when you finish deploying the nanites?  If so, you will earn a diamond medal, and an achievement which "Blue 42" earns the nickname "Blur 42" because of his great speed!  This will probably be the hardest achievement to get in Planetary Settlers for a while, are you up for the challenge?

notes.title: Alien Awakening Update
notes.notes:
They're here!  Make your way from Mars, inward toward the A'kramm vessel orbiting the sun, and see if you can save Earth from further catastrophe! notes.title: Getting ready for release
notes.notes: Planetary Settlers is approved for Early Access release, scheduled for May 30th, 2018.  I am busy polishing it up, fixing bugs, and adding features.  I have the inner solar system ready for action, with Mars, the Moon, Earth, Venus, and Mercury levels available, each with realistic gravity.   Missions are implemented, and the first main quest is implemented.  Work your way from Mars, inward through the solar system as you try to re-establish contact with humanity, and find out what caused the devastating solar flare!  I look forward to your thoughts and inputs.  You have the opportunity to shape the future of this game!  I am planning on adding the outer solar system planets, asteroid belt, and more missions for the current levels, as well as fixing bugs, and enhancing the current experience.
